fluff.overview: Despite the low regard most Clans hold for conventional infantry, these formations benefit from incidental access to Clan technology that makes even a disaffected garrison Point a match for its Inner Sphere equivalent. Jump Points are equipped with jump packs that grant vertical mobility and the ability to traverse rough terrain that would slow or stop foot and mechanized formations. This makes them valuable in urban fighting, mountainous terrain, and any environment where the ability to bypass obstacles matters more than sustained speed. Support troops carry man-portable flamers that project streams of burning chemicals, providing devastating area-effect capability against infantry and structures at the cost of short range and the vulnerability of the operator's fuel tank.
